units.nameZh: 共同基线把两组日期连成一条
units.nameEn: One baseline holds two date groups together
units.descriptionZh:
年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。
两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。
units.descriptionEn:
Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.
Two number groups sit on one shared baseline. The repeating year shrinks below it so the changing month and day read first.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。

sectionsEn.label: Composition
sectionsEn.text: Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.

sectionsEn.label: Method
sectionsEn.text: Two number groups sit on one shared baseline. The repeating year shrinks below it so the changing month and day read first.

units.nameZh: 两组宽度按黄金比切分
units.nameEn: Split the two groups at the golden ratio
units.descriptionZh:
左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。
左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。
units.descriptionEn:
The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.
A vertical rule stands between the two groups. The span from the left margin to the rule and from the rule to the right margin measure roughly 1 to 0.618.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。

sectionsEn.label: Composition
sectionsEn.text: The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.

sectionsEn.label: Method
sectionsEn.text: A vertical rule stands between the two groups. The span from the left margin to the rule and from the rule to the right margin measure roughly 1 to 0.618.

units.nameZh: 用引线把副行撑满主字宽度
units.nameEn: Dashes stretch the sub-line to the main width
units.descriptionZh:
破折号当引线，让副行两端与主字两端重合。
主数字 12.30 下面一行小字，靠两根破折号把字距拉开，左右两端正好抵住主数字的左右边界，上下两行齐头齐尾。
units.descriptionEn:
Em dashes act as leaders so the sub-line matches the figure above.
Under the main figure 12.30 runs a small line. Two em dashes spread it so its ends land exactly on the left and right edges of the figure above, making the two rows flush at both ends.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 破折号当引线，让副行两端与主字两端重合。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 主数字 12.30 下面一行小字，靠两根破折号把字距拉开，左右两端正好抵住主数字的左右边界，上下两行齐头齐尾。

sectionsEn.label: Composition
sectionsEn.text: Em dashes act as leaders so the sub-line matches the figure above.

sectionsEn.label: Method
sectionsEn.text: Under the main figure 12.30 runs a small line. Two em dashes spread it so its ends land exactly on the left and right edges of the figure above, making the two rows flush at both ends.

units.nameZh: 字形当窗口，一幅图案贯穿全词
units.nameEn: Letters as a window: one pattern runs through the word
units.descriptionZh:
图案只在整词上铺一次，由字的轮廓裁切出来。
各字里的条纹、星点相位必须彼此对得上；一旦对不上，一眼就看出是逐字各贴了一份。
units.descriptionEn:
The pattern is laid down once across the whole word and the letterforms crop it.
The stripes and stars have to hold one phase from letter to letter. The moment they do not line up, the fill reads as decoration pasted into each letter.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 图案只在整词上铺一次，由字的轮廓裁切出来。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 各字里的条纹、星点相位必须彼此对得上；一旦对不上，一眼就看出是逐字各贴了一份。

sectionsEn.text: The pattern is laid down once across the whole word and the letterforms crop it.

sectionsEn.label: Method

units.nameZh: 内线字：笔画里嵌一条细线
units.nameEn: Inline: one hairline runs inside the stroke
units.descriptionZh:
粗笔画沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，字立刻透气。
笔画照常填色，只沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，两端各留一小段不切通。字越粗，这条线救回的呼吸越多。
units.descriptionEn:
A heavy stroke keeps one line of the ground showing along its centre, and the letter breathes again.
Fill the stroke as usual but leave one line of background along its centre axis, stopping short of both ends. The heavier the face, the more that line gives back.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 粗笔画沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，字立刻透气。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 笔画照常填色，只沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，两端各留一小段不切通。字越粗，这条线救回的呼吸越多。

sectionsEn.text: A heavy stroke keeps one line of the ground showing along its centre, and the letter breathes again.

sectionsEn.label: Method

units.nameZh: 大字号改空心，线宽与线图同值
units.nameEn: Hollow type: stroke weight matched to the line art
units.descriptionZh:
大标题只描边不填色，描边粗细取画面线图的线宽。
字号一大，实心字就把插画压死；改成空心，并把描边粗细调成与线稿完全同一个值，字与图才落在同一层上。
units.descriptionEn:
A huge title is drawn as an outline only, at the same weight as the lines of the drawing.
At display size a solid fill flattens the illustration. Switch the type to an outline and set its weight to exactly the drawing's line weight, and type and art sit on one layer.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 大标题只描边不填色，描边粗细取画面线图的线宽。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 字号一大，实心字就把插画压死；改成空心，并把描边粗细调成与线稿完全同一个值，字与图才落在同一层上。

sectionsEn.label: Composition
sectionsEn.text: A huge title is drawn as an outline only, at the same weight as the lines of the drawing.

sectionsEn.label: Method
sectionsEn.text: At display size a solid fill flattens the illustration. Switch the type to an outline and set its weight to exactly the drawing's line weight, and type and art sit on one layer.

units.nameZh: 弧线基线：逐字转到切线角
units.nameEn: Arc baseline: every glyph turns to the tangent
units.descriptionZh:
整行字沿一条圆弧走，每个字按所在位置的切线角自转。
先定圆弧，再把每个字绕自己的基线点转到该处的切线角；弯道外侧会拉开，必须补一点负字距，否则词在弧上散架。
units.descriptionEn:
The line rides an arc and each glyph rotates to the tangent at its own position.
Fix the arc first, then rotate each glyph about its own baseline point to the tangent there. The outside of the curve opens up, so pull some of that gap back or the word falls apart along the arc.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 整行字沿一条圆弧走，每个字按所在位置的切线角自转。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 先定圆弧，再把每个字绕自己的基线点转到该处的切线角；弯道外侧会拉开，必须补一点负字距，否则词在弧上散架。

sectionsEn.text: The line rides an arc and each glyph rotates to the tangent at its own position.

sectionsEn.label: Method
sectionsEn.text: Fix the arc first, then rotate each glyph about its own baseline point to the tangent there. The outside of the curve opens up, so pull some of that gap back or the word falls apart along the arc.

units.nameZh: 虚词缩小，夹在两段实词之间
units.nameEn: Function words shrink and bridge the two content words
units.descriptionZh:
虚词降到实词的三分之一，换成斜体，卡在两个实词之间的缝里。
the cat 与 mermouse 一样大，中间的 and the 缩到约三分之一、换成斜体，落位略偏上，把上下两个实词缝成一个标题。
units.descriptionEn:
The small words drop to a third of the content words, switch to italic, and sit in the gap between them.
THE CAT and MERMOUSE carry the same size; the and the in between drops to about a third, switches to italic and sits slightly high, stitching the two content words into one title.
